summary: Practise GHS label checks, SDS review, chemical storage and spill-response planning. Explore the five-day chemical handling training course.
lede: Chemical handling training helps laboratory, warehouse and production staff identify hazards and apply controls during routine chemical tasks. It covers checking GHS labels and safety data sheets, assessing task risks, separating incompatible products, and choosing exposure controls for storage, transfer and use. Learners also practise preparing task references and drafting storage, spill-response and action-plan documents for review with supervisors.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who receive, store, prepare, transfer or supervise chemicals in routine workplace tasks, including staff who maintain chemical information and respond to initial spill or exposure concerns.
prerequisites: Bring familiarity with your own workplace tasks involving or near chemicals. No specialist chemical-safety background is assumed.
